Your holdings: SOXL (-51.98%) and SPAL (-44.89%) are major concerns due to their leveraged nature and significant drawdowns. Remember margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the bond market's reaction to Treasury efforts and the performance of your "TRIM" status positions like SMH and QQQI.

Bottom line: Focus on aggressive risk management, especially on your leveraged positions, given the current market uncertainty.
plays: SOXL: Your stop at 200 is inactive; consider a hard stop below current price, perhaps 120, to limit further decay on this leveraged position.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, your stop at 21.38 is not active. Set a tighter stop, perhaps around 13.50, to manage risk on this new, leveraged holding.
CRWD: Scanner suggests accumulation near 190.15-189.96 with a stop at 189.53. Watch for this entry if you want to add to your profitable position.
